title: Jimmy Kimmel roasts Trump over his meeting with AI executives
excerpt: He's determined to make "Super Intelligence" happen.
content_html:
He's determined to make "Super Intelligence" happen.

 

By

Sam Haysom

Sam Haysom

Sam Haysom is the General Assignment Editor, UK, for Mashable. He covers entertainment and online culture, and writes horror fiction in his spare time.

Read Full Bio

 

on September 30, 2026

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Flipboard

Trump had a meeting with tech leaders recently, where he once again banged on about changing the name of artificial intelligence to "super intelligence" — with Jimmy Kimmel playing a clip of him saying "everybody likes it."

"Yes, I'm sure the guy whose company's name is OpenAI is very excited about this development," says Kimmel in the monologue above. "He's obsessed with changing the names of things. Ever since Don Jr. he's been in love with changing the names of things.

"The idea that our guardrails against AI are being erected by an 80-year-old man, it's like asking your grandpa to set up a WiFi router in your house. You just wouldn't do it."
